description: This PHP source file defines a REST API class 'InterviewAttachmentAPI' for managing interview attachments within a recruitment plugin of an HR management system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting interview attachments, leveraging various traits and models. The class is intended to be an endpoint for an API, utilizing annotations for API documentation, and handling parameters, validation, and data transformations.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing interview attachments, providing CRUD operations with validation and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all interview attachments with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new interview attachment.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific interview attachment by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update details of an existing interview attachment.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove one or more interview attachments.
